media.title: Ihre Majestät die Liebe (1931) — Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 161
media.description: Illustrierter Film-Kurier cover for the film Ihre Majestät die Liebe (1931), directed by Joe May; a European-period film with music by Bronisław Kaper (Film F004).
media.altText: Illustrated Film-Kurier cover for Ihre Majestät die Liebe, showing film-promotion artwork and issue text.
media.rightsNote: Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 161 (Berlin, 1931). Reviewed 2026-07-05: no individual cover designer credited. Anonymous German work, published 1931 → PD ~2002 (§66 UrhG, 70 yrs); underlying photo PD as Lichtbild (50 yrs); reproductions of PD 2-D works stay PD (EU DSM Art. 14). Rights upgraded fair-use → OK (public domain). Assumes no designer later identified; not legal advice. Credit: 'Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 161 (public domain)'.

works.title: Ihre Majestät die Liebe
works.publicNote: Bronisław Kaper’s involvement in this film is currently considered probable, but his role has not been established. The only positive attribution identified so far is IMDb, where he is listed as “Benjamin Kapper”; Filmportal and Walter Jurmann estate materials do not independently confirm the credit.
